callouts.label: Face
callouts.text: Large amber-brown eyes under soft arched brows. A warm upturned smile and three tiny freckles on her right cheek.

callouts.label: Hair
callouts.text: The part sits to her left. Narrow tapered chestnut spirals frame the cheeks, fan over the shoulder blades and turn honey-brown toward the tips.

callouts.label: Tailoring
callouts.text: A cropped gold satin jacket opens over an emerald scoop-neck dress. Turned cuffs and warm gold piping frame the shoulder and waist.

callouts.label: Accessories
callouts.text: Gold hoops and a double necklace; the teardrop pendant rests at the center. A crossbody strap runs from her left shoulder to her right hip.

callouts.label: Lantern
callouts.text: Her left hand carries a six-sided brass lantern. Two dark bands and an arched bail hold its honey-colored panes.
